# Rolling Chat Bok

Private template for dedicated Bok source mirrors. Contains no application secrets or user data.
readOnlyLiveChecks.description: Dedicated installation anchor for the restricted Rolling Chat Bok GitHub App; no user data or application secrets.
readOnlyLiveChecks.method: Existing gh authenticated GET repository, Actions permissions, refs, commit, tree and README only; no token issuance or mutation.

blockers.fact: Current117-byte template README and description fail exact pool genesis/marker admission. Same broker configuration expressly excludes pool/template identity overlap and binds immutable state.config.

Legacy sync invokes template() even for already-created repositories, validating original fullName,is_template and current default-branch head b3e8. The template-backed journal owns existingB1419307628 andC1419512819 mirrors; changing bootstrap name/default HEAD or clearing template status would prevent future normal updates/reconciliation through that journal.

assessment: No thread is allocated to bootstrap in the three located production broker journals, but it is not unused: its immutable template authority is a live dependency. Other three selected repositories are claimed and must not be repurposed. Only currently exposed ref is main; no application source exists in bootstrap itself. This does not prove absence of undiscovered external users.
limits: No GitHub settings, refs, contents, permissions, selection, source, private journals or financial state changed.
Existing selection state comes from current lead context and recorded installation-pending evidence; this review did not mint an App token to re-enumerate selection.
No new pool transport or per-thread admission acceptance is claimed.
disposition: Stop this alternative. Preserve bootstrap, immutable configurations and all three claimed mirrors. Existing pending normal pool-selection reauthentication remains the supported handoff; no migration, retirement, rename or new user question proposed.
